verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a card-issuing platform, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Marqeta's core platform. Everything shown is Marqeta-run: its sandbox, Core API and MCP Server. Running your own webhook receiver or JIT funding decision endpoint is customer-side integration, not self-hosting the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
